hyperedges.label: Order Status Lifecycle & Stock Decrement Flow
API-Wide Cross-Cutting Conventions (Validation, Pagination, Fail-Closed Auth)

nodes.label: Prisma 7 Driver Adapter Requirement
nodes.rationale: Prisma 7 breaks backward compatibility: PrismaClient no longer accepts a connection string in the schema - it requires a driver adapter (@prisma/adapter-pg) passed to the constructor; PrismaService builds it from process.env.DATABASE_URL. prisma.config.ts is only used by the CLI, never by the runtime client. The generator also needs moduleFormat='cjs' in schema.prisma, otherwise it emits ESM (import.meta.url) which breaks when loaded from this CommonJS project.

nodes.label: Global ValidationPipe (RNF-03)
nodes.rationale: All write routes validate the body with class-validator (RNF-03) via a global ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true, transform: true }).

nodes.label: Pagination Convention (RNF-06)
nodes.rationale: Collection GET listings accept ?page=&pageSize= (RNF-06) and return { data, meta: { page, pageSize, total, totalPages } } consistently across modules.

nodes.label: RolesGuard Fail-Closed Default (RNF-02)
nodes.rationale: No real JWT exists yet (Proximos Pasos #7); RolesGuard resolves every actor as PUBLICO, so any route not explicitly PUBLICO-permitted returns 403. This is intentional fail-closed behavior per RNF-02, not a bug; verified via curl that POST /categories without auth returns 403.

nodes.label: Atomic Conditional UPDATE for Stock Decrement
nodes.rationale: InventoryService.applyMovement() is the only place in the system that mutates stock, always in the same transaction as the InventoryMovement insert (RNF-01). Outbound movements use an atomic UPDATE ... WHERE stock >= quantity - no SELECT FOR UPDATE, no Serializable isolation - the WHERE condition itself prevents two concurrent outbound movements from overselling the same variant. Verified with a real concurrency test.
nodes.norm_label: atomic conditional update for stock decrement

nodes.label: Simplified Inventory Turnover Formula
nodes.rationale: GET /reports/inventory-turnover computes units sold in period divided by current total stock - a simplification, not a formal COGS/average-inventory ratio; see comment in reports.service.ts.

nodes.label: Concurrent Checkout Stock Test
nodes.rationale: Two concurrent guest checkouts against insufficient stock were tested directly against the real services (bypassing HTTP since all non-public routes 403 without JWT): one is cleanly rejected and stock never goes negative - validating the atomic stock-decrement mechanism under concurrency.

nodes.label: Gap: No Real JWT Yet
nodes.rationale: Missing JwtStrategy + JwtAuthGuard to populate request.user with the shape of AuthenticatedUser from the token; until implemented, RolesGuard treats every actor as PUBLICO.

nodes.label: Gap: No Notifications Module (RF-20/RF-23)
nodes.rationale: No email or internal notification module exists; order status-change endpoints do not notify anyone yet.

nodes.label: Gap: No Persistent Production DB
nodes.rationale: All documented tests ran against an ephemeral local Postgres (npx prisma dev); production needs Railway/Render/Fly.io and prisma migrate dev (not just db push) for real migration history.

nodes.label: Gap: No Rate Limiting on Public Write Routes
nodes.rationale: POST /orders and POST /customers/register have no throttling; not in original RF/RNF scope but a typical omission before exposing to the internet.
nodes.norm_label: gap: no rate limiting on public write routes

nodes.label: ProductVariant.stock Source-of-Truth Pattern
nodes.rationale: stock is stored as a field, not derived by summing InventoryMovement on each read, for performance in catalog listings (RNF-06); always updated within the same DB transaction that inserts the InventoryMovement row (RNF-01) so balance and history never diverge.

nodes.label: InventoryMovement Append-Only Pattern
nodes.rationale: InventoryMovement rows are never edited or deleted; corrections are made via new adjustment movements (AJUSTE_ENTRADA/AJUSTE_SALIDA), making the RF-04 history and RF-12 audit trail reliable.

nodes.label: Guest Checkout via Nullable Customer.passwordHash
nodes.rationale: Customer.passwordHash is nullable to support guest checkout (RF-17/RF-19): an order always requires a Customer, but it can be created with just email/name/phone at checkout time without an account; if the customer registers later, passwordHash is filled on the same record found by email.

nodes.label: AuditLog Polymorphic entityType/entityId Design
nodes.rationale: AuditLog uses generic entityType + entityId instead of a FK per auditable entity type, to avoid touching the schema every time a new table needs auditing.

nodes.label: Category Self-Referential Subcategories
nodes.rationale: Category has a self-relation (parentId) to support one additional level of subcategory nesting (RF-06) in v1; an arbitrarily deep tree was not modeled because requerimientos.md doesn't call for it.

nodes.label: Decimal (not Float) for Monetary Amounts
nodes.rationale: All money fields (cost, basePrice, unitCost, unitPrice, subtotal, total) use Decimal instead of Float to avoid rounding errors in financial calculations.

nodes.label: RF-18: Immediate Stock Decrement (No Reservation)
nodes.rationale: On order confirmation, ProductVariant.stock is decremented in the same transaction that creates the Order, its OrderItems and the InventoryMovement (VENTA_SALIDA) - no intermediate 'reserved' state or TTL reservation table. Concurrent buyers competing for the same variant require reading stock with a lock (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE or Serializable isolation) and rejecting the sale if insufficient, to satisfy RNF-01 and avoid overselling.
